dataset_name: Nutrition Atlas — Country Malnutrition Profile Dataset
description: Production data artifact containing multi-source country malnutrition indicators, similarity clustering, and peer benchmarks.

stunting.label: Child Stunting (% under 5)
stunting.source: UNICEF / WHO / World Bank Joint Malnutrition Estimates (March 2026)
stunting.description: Height-for-age < -2 standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.
stunting.relevance: Key marker of chronic undernutrition and structural deprivation in early childhood.

child_overweight.label: Child Overweight (% under 5)
child_overweight.source: UNICEF / WHO / World Bank Joint Malnutrition Estimates (March 2026)
child_overweight.description: Weight-for-height > +2 standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.
child_overweight.relevance: Emerging form of paediatric malnutrition signaling nutrition transition.

wasting.label: Child Wasting (% under 5)
wasting.source: Global Nutrition Report (Country Nutrition Profiles Feb 2023)
wasting.description: Weight-for-height < -2 standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.
wasting.relevance: Acute malnutrition indicator reflecting rapid weight loss or failure to gain weight.

adult_obesity.label: Adult Obesity (%)
adult_obesity.source: Global Nutrition Report (Country Nutrition Profiles Feb 2023)
adult_obesity.relevance: Primary driver of metabolic non-communicable diseases (NCDs) and cardiovascular morbidity.

adult_diabetes.label: Adult Diabetes (%)
adult_diabetes.source: Global Nutrition Report (Country Nutrition Profiles Feb 2023)
adult_diabetes.description: Fasting blood glucose >= 7.0 mmol/L or on medication for raised blood glucose.
adult_diabetes.relevance: Major metabolic chronic outcome directly linked to dietary quality and adiposity.

anaemia_women.label: Anaemia in Women of Reproductive Age (%)
anaemia_women.source: Global Nutrition Report (Country Nutrition Profiles Feb 2023)
anaemia_women.description: Haemoglobin concentration < 120 g/L for non-pregnant and < 110 g/L for pregnant women.
anaemia_women.relevance: Pivotal indicator of micronutrient deficiency (iron, folate) affecting maternal-child health.

low_birth_weight.label: Low Birth Weight (% of live births)
low_birth_weight.description: Birth weight strictly less than 2,500 grams (up to and including 2,499 g).
low_birth_weight.relevance: Early life proxy for intrauterine growth restriction and maternal undernutrition.

child_anaemia.label: Prevalence of Anaemia in Children (% of children under 5)
child_anaemia.relevance: Contextual validation indicator. Excluded from clustering due to strong correlation (~0.90) with anaemia in women to avoid double-weighting.

exclusive_breastfeeding.label: Exclusive Breastfeeding (% under 6 months)
exclusive_breastfeeding.source: Global Nutrition Report (Country Nutrition Profiles Feb 2023)
exclusive_breastfeeding.relevance: Infant feeding protection factor used solely in sensitivity analysis.

mandatory_caveat: Groups are exploratory similarity groupings, not official categories or rankings. Data years differ between indicators. Not for clinical use.
